conflict: Target User is an authenticated LMS account with one operational role; PAI User/Actor is organization-scoped and supports memberships, role assignments and scoped delegation.
decision: LMS owns account/auth; PAI consumes a trusted actor contract; do not merge tables.

conflict: PAI requires organization isolation in persistence and policy; target has no organization/tenant model.
decision: UNDECIDED; require product decision before production integration.

conflict: PAI CV/JD document has quarantine, hash, retention and extraction eligibility; target Document is a published training resource attached to Course.
PAI CourseBlueprint is competency-aligned generated design with objectives/prerequisites/provenance; target Course is a published enrollment/delivery product.
decision: PAI blueprint projects into an LMS Course; no table/entity merge.

conflict: PAI LearningPath is generated from approved gaps/verified competencies; target LearningPath is staff-authored Course collection with assignments.
decision: Use separate concepts; projection may populate target drafts only.

conflict: PAI assessment requires rubric, evidence, artifact, SME review and competency decision; target QuizAttempt calculates learner score/pass.
PAI objective has measurable outcome and competency/gap alignment; target Lesson has title/content/order but no objective semantics.
decision: PAI owns meaning; LMS receives optional projection metadata.

conflict: PAI Evidence has source locator/excerpt/confidence/verification status; target has no evidence model.
decision: PAI-only initially; exchange opaque references or LearningResult contract.

conflict: PAI supports provisional/assessed/verified/expired/revoked states; target has no competency domain and its Role enum is operational RBAC.
decision: PAI owns persistence/API; never map to target Role or CourseCategory.

conflict: Target Certificate is course completion; PAI Credential is policy-gated competency/learning assertion with approval, validity and revocation.
decision: Separate lifecycle and source of truth.

conflict: Target JWT/CASL roles differ from PAI trusted actor, organization and SME delegation rules.
decision: LMS authenticates; PAI authorizes PAI decisions from trusted context.

conflict: Target Prisma and source SQLAlchemy/Alembic have independent schemas and histories.
decision: No shared DB or migration replay; use APIs/events and context-owned persistence.
